This dataset contains the three (3) files (.prj, .wtif, .tif) that create the orthomosaic captured by the Capture2Preserv team with the Mavic Mini 3 Pro. Three hundred and two (302) images were collected from 22nd-23rd August 2022 and processed in Pix4D Mapper V.4.7.5.
